title: Max building height 15m for plotted housing without stilt parking (Terms & conditions iii)

citations.original_text: Height: the maximum height for building shall be 15m in plots without stilt parking and 17.5m in plots with stilt parking.

notes: Such building not considered high rise; Fire Department clearance required by plot owner.
user_caveat: At this height the building is not classed as high-rise, but Fire Department clearance remains the plot owner's responsibility.
